title: Top hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="hatBody" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4a2a8a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2d1a5e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hatTop" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#6a4ac0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4a2a8a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="brimGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5a3aa5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#3a2078"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bandGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e8c84a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c9a030"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Brim (ellipse) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="38" ry="12" fill="url(#brimGrad)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="38" ry="12" fill="url(#brimGrad)"/>

  <!-- Hat body (cylinder) -->
  <rect x="26" y="26" width="48" height="50" rx="2" fill="url(#hatBody)"/>

  <!-- Hat body shading highlight on left -->
  <rect x="26" y="26" width="8" height="50" rx="1" fill="#5a3ab0" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Hat top (ellipse) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="26" rx="24" ry="8" fill="url(#hatTop)"/>

  <!-- Hat band -->
  <rect x="26" y="62" width="48" height="10" fill="url(#bandGrad)"/>

  <!-- Band highlight -->
  <rect x="26" y="62" width="48" height="3" fill="#f8e07a" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Band buckle -->
  <rect x="42" y="61" width="16" height="12" rx="2" fill="#f0d060"/>
  <rect x="45" y="64" width="10" height="6" rx="1" fill="#b89020"/>

  <!-- Buckle center prong -->
  <rect x="49" y="63" width="2" height="8" fill="#f0d060"/>

  <!-- Shine on hat body -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="44" rx="4" ry="10" fill="#9a7ae0" opacity="0.35"/>
</svg>
